notes:
2026-09-16 (fin/26-50 re-triage, 4-lane split): re-ran apply-recognizers.mjs/verify-synergy.mjs fresh (per the new lane process, not trusting the old single-agent sweep's report) — still fully recognizer-covered (0 AI facts), 0 hard failures. No change needed.

2026-09-12: trimmed to exactly 1 scenario per the standing "default 1 scenario, real basic function" rule (user ask: "1 scenario is enough here. legend rule, lifelink check etc is not needed. we can just check anthem works."). Dropped the 2nd scenario (the not-Clerics negative-case edge test — same no-op-branch anti-pattern trimmed elsewhere) and dropped the `...keywordScenarios(minwuWhiteMage)` spread (generic Lifelink-combat-damage + legend-rule probes) entirely, along with its now-unused imports.

Caught a real dependency before finishing: a bare `trigger:'onLifeGained'`-only scenario starts `self` already on the Battlefield (harness.ts's own `runScenario`), so it produces NO cast/enters/combat-damage trace evidence at all — that would have orphaned 3 already-declared, real synergy.json SOURCE facts (`cast`, `entersBattlefield`, and the Lifelink `lifegain` fact, CR 702.15e) with zero trace backing, hard-failing verify-synergy (a real `process.exit(1)` gate). No legendRule fact is declared for this card, so dropping the legend-rule probe itself was free of any such tie. Resolved by keeping the ONE combined scenario real instead of synthetic: no top-level `trigger` (so cast+enters lifecycle actually happens), `dealsCombatDamage` (real Lifelink lifegain, same CR 702.15e mechanism aerith-gainsborough's own engine-trace pilot demonstrates), plus `sequence:['onLifeGained']` to fire the anthem trigger — still exactly 1 scenario object, no separate keyword-scenario spam, no legend rule. verify-synergy (single-card + full pool) and vitest both clean; only a pre-existing-class informational note remains (`dealDamage` trace line with no matching declared produce — same harmless note the old Lifelink probe always produced, dealDamage itself was never declared as a fact, only its Lifelink-caused gainLife consequence is). Regenerated trace.json via run-scenarios.mjs; confirmed live via /api/card/fin/26 — functionalModel.traces has exactly 1 entry.

Restored real lifegain SOURCE fact for printed Lifelink (CR 702.15e exception to bare-keyword rule, SYNERGY_DESIGN.md). Annotated via 'lifelink' in oracle line 0. verify-synergy/vitest clean.

Migrated to the unified Fact model (fin/1-20 rollout continuation). Real oracle text confirmed against data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #26: {3}{W}{W}, Legendary Creature — Human Cleric, 3/3, "Vigilance, lifelink\nWhenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on each Cleric you control." Vigilance/Lifelink are bare printed keywords (self-only, no grant/broadcast) — no Fact per the 2026-09-12 standing rule; dropped the old lifegain SOURCE fact that used to represent the card's own lifelink. Dropped the old self-dies/self-graveyard baseline facts too — this card has no real death-related oracle text to anchor them to (same precedent as adelbert-steiner/ambrosia-whiteheart/cloud-midgar-mercenary, all plain creatures with no death text of their own). New putCounter broadcast (SOURCE) mirrors the-crystal-s-chosen's own unconditional +1/+1 broadcast shape, narrowed to types:{has:['Cleric']} instead of all creatures (oracle says "each Cleric you control", not creature). New wants-lifegain SINK (event:'lifegain', controller:'you') mirrors aerith-gainsborough's identical sink verbatim (same oracle phrase, same span). New wants-cleric-presence SINK (to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Cleric']}) mirrors aerith-gainsborough's own legendary-creature presence sink, narrowed to Cleric. All 5 facts annotated via annotations-authoring.json + compute-annotations.mjs; slug added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS.
